title: New Shoes
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother George.
lines.zh: 我是佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治。

lines.en: This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig. Peppa Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈。这是猪爸爸。小猪佩奇。

lines.en: New shoes.
Peppa and George have been playing in the garden.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治一直在花园里玩耍。

lines.en: Peppa, where are your shoes?
Oh, I've lost them.
Well, I'm sure we can find them. Maybe we should try the garden.
lines.zh: 好吧，我相信我们能找到他们。也许我们应该去花园试试。

lines.en: Yes!
Everyone is looking for Peppa's shoes.
lines.zh: 大家都在找佩奇的鞋子。

lines.en: Mummy Pig is looking in the flower bed. Peppa's shoes are not there.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈正在花坛里寻找。佩奇的鞋子不在那里。

lines.en: Daddy Pig is looking in the wheelbarrow. Peppa's shoes are not there.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸正在独轮车里寻找。佩奇的鞋子不在那里。

lines.en: Oh!
Peppa and George look in the flower pots. Peppa's shoes are not there either.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治在花盆里看。佩奇的鞋子也不在那里。

lines.en: Oh!
We've looked everywhere, but we can't find Peppa's shoes.
lines.zh: 我们到处都找遍了，就是找不到佩奇的鞋子。

lines.en: Peppa's shoes are lost.
Now I haven't got any shoes to wear.
lines.zh: 现在我没有鞋子可穿了。

lines.en: Poor Peppa. Your shoes were getting a bit old. We'll buy you a new pair.
lines.zh: 可怜的佩奇。你的鞋子有点旧了。我们会给你买一双新的。

lines.en: Can my new shoes be red, Mummy?
lines.zh: 妈妈，我的新鞋可以是红色的吗？

lines.en: Of course they can.
George, I'm going to have new red shoes.
lines.zh: 乔治，我要买新的红鞋了。

lines.en: Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Miss Rabbit's shoe shop.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈和佩奇在兔小姐的鞋店。

lines.en: Hello, Miss Rabbit.
Hello, Mummy Pig.
We would like to buy some new shoes for Peppa, please.
lines.zh: 我们想给佩奇买一些新鞋。

lines.en: Red shoes.
Oh, I'm sure we can find you some lovely new shoes, Peppa.
lines.zh: 哦，我相信我们能为你找到一些可爱的新鞋，佩奇。

lines.en: Red ones, please.
Of course. Red ones.
Wow!
New red shoes.
George and Daddy Pig are playing drafts.
lines.zh: 乔治和猪爸爸正在玩跳棋。

lines.en: Oh, well done, George.
Daddy, Daddy.
Look at my new shoes. They're red.
lines.zh: 看看我的新鞋。它们是红色的。

lines.en: I say, they are red.
Mummy, do you like my new shoes?
lines.zh: 妈妈，你喜欢我的新鞋吗？

lines.en: Yes, Peppa. They make you look very smart.
lines.zh: 是的，佩奇。它们让你看起来很聪明。

lines.en: George, do you like my new shoes?
lines.zh: 乔治，你喜欢我的新鞋吗？

lines.en: Everyone likes Peppa's new shoes.
lines.zh: 大家都喜欢佩奇的新鞋。

lines.en: I like my new shoes so much.
I don't want to ever take them off.
It is bath time.
Peppa wants to keep her new shoes on, even for her bath.
lines.zh: 佩奇想穿着她的新鞋，即使是洗澡。

lines.en: Peppa is in her pyjamas. She still has her new shoes on.
lines.zh: 佩奇穿着睡衣。她还穿着新鞋。

lines.en: Peppa even wants to wear her new shoes in bed.
lines.zh: 佩奇甚至想在床上穿她的新鞋。

lines.en: Peppa, are you sure you don't want to take your shoes off?
lines.zh: 佩奇，你确定不想脱鞋吗？

lines.en: I don't want to ever take my new shoes off, Mummy.
lines.zh: 我不想脱掉我的新鞋，妈妈。

lines.en: Very well. Good night, Peppa and George.
Good night, Mummy.
Good night, Daddy.
Good night, my little piggies.
It has been raining all night, and now the garden is very wet.
lines.zh: 下了整晚的雨，现在花园很湿。

lines.en: Mummy Pig is wearing her boots.
Daddy Pig is wearing his boots.
George is wearing his boots.
Peppa is still wearing her new red shoes.
lines.zh: 佩奇还穿着她的新红鞋。

lines.en: George is going to play in the wet grass.
lines.zh: 乔治要在湿漉漉的草地上玩耍。

lines.en: Oh, dear. Peppa loves playing in the wet grass,
lines.zh: 哦，亲爱的。佩奇喜欢在湿漉漉的草地上玩耍，

lines.en: but she doesn't want to get her new shoes wet.
lines.zh: 但她不想弄湿她的新鞋。

lines.en: I can't play in the wet grass, George.
lines.zh: 我不能在湿草地上玩耍，乔治。

lines.en: Oh.
George loves jumping in muddy puddles.
Peppa loves jumping in puddles,
but she doesn't want to get her new shoes muddy.
lines.zh: 但她不想让她的新鞋沾满泥。

lines.en: Mummy and Daddy love jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 妈妈和爸爸最喜欢在泥坑里跳来跳去。

lines.en: Everyone likes jumping in muddy puddles.
Where is Peppa going?
Peppa is putting on her boots.
Whee!
If you jump in muddy puddles, you must wear your boots.
lines.zh: 如果跳泥坑，必须穿靴子。

lines.en: Peppa Pig
Peppa Pig
Peppa Pig
